steps.cmd: [builder 9/10] RUN --mount=type=tmpfs,target=/tmp/cupy-wheel set -eu; python -m zipfile -e /wheels/*.whl /tmp/cupy-wheel; count=$(find /tmp/cupy-wheel -name '*.so' | wc -l); echo "shared objects in wheel: ${count}"; [ "${count}" -gt 0 ] || { echo "wheel contains no extensions" >&2; exit 1; }; for so in $(find /tmp/cupy-wheel -name '*.so' | head -20); do /opt/rocm/llvm/bin/llvm-objdump --offloading "${so}" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'gfx[0-9a-z]+' || true; done | sort -u | tee /wheels-arch.txt; echo "arch bundles found: $(wc -l < /wheels-arch.txt)"

[builder 8/10] RUN --mount=type=secret,id=aws,required=false if [ -s /run/secrets/aws ]; then set -a; . /run/secrets/aws; set +a; fi; njobs="8"; if [ -z "${njobs}" ]; then cores=$(nproc); njobs=$(awk -v per="2" '/^MemAvailable:/ {print int($2/1024/1024/per)}' /proc/meminfo); [ -n "${njobs}" ] || njobs=${cores}; [ "${njobs}" -ge 1 ] || njobs=1; [ "${njobs}" -le "${cores}" ] || njobs=${cores}; fi; export CUPY_NUM_BUILD_JOBS="${njobs}"; echo "CUPY_NUM_BUILD_JOBS=${njobs}, HCC_AMDGPU_TARGET=gfx1250"; CC="sccache gcc" CXX="sccache g++" PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python build-wheel.py bdist_wheel --dist-dir=/wheels 2>&1 | tee /wheels-build.log && sccache --show-stats | tee /wheels-cupy-sccache-stats.txt
